name: comp-544

frames.best_why: Empty dashed box with the icon and "Drop your image here", the clearest upload state.

tagline: Dashed box that takes a dropped image and fills with a preview.
summary: A dashed rounded panel inviting you to drop an image or click to browse, with a 5MB note underneath. Once a file loads, the panel becomes the picture itself, with a round close button in the corner.
appearance: A wide rounded rectangle outlined by a fine dashed border on black. In the middle a small circle holds a photo-with-up-arrow glyph, followed by a bold white instruction and a dimmer size note. Loaded, it becomes a blue gradient image with a dark round X at the top right.
behaviour: Dragging a file over the box lightens its fill; dropping or browsing swaps the whole area for the chosen picture and reveals the remove button. Files over 5MB instead raise a red error line.
demo_content: Empty dropzone reading Max size: 5MB, then a blue gradient test image; caption links to an API doc.
search_phrases: drag and drop image upload box
upload a profile picture by dropping a file
dashed box that says drop your image here
image preview uploader with remove button
single photo upload with size limit
dropzone that fills with the chosen picture
click to browse for an image
upload area showing max size warning
use_when: One image must be chosen and previewed in place, such as a cover or avatar.
avoid_when: It accepts a single image capped at 5MB and offers no crop, resize or multiple-file support.
customise: The 5MB ceiling, the image-only filter and all the copy are written in the file; colours and the dashed border follow theme tokens.
weight_why: A hidden file input and one preview image; no animation loop.

a11y.note: The hidden file input is labelled and shows a focus ring, but the clickable wrapper is kept out of the tab order.

issues: The caption is developer copy ending in an API link, not a description.
The empty state names the size limit but never the accepted formats.
The whole box is clickable yet the wrapper is excluded from keyboard tabbing.
polish_why: Clear empty state, tidy dragging highlight and a clean preview with remove button.
title: Image Cover Dropzone
